verdict.rationale_short: A twin-catalyst breakdown — US-Iran kinetic conflict resumption plus a hawkish FOMC minutes at 2:00 PM ET — simultaneously dismantles the HOLD regime constructed over the prior two sessions. Brent crude surged 5.92% to $78.55, WTI +5.79% to $74.75. US-led Joint Maritime Information Center elevated Hormuz threat to 'SEVERE.' (2) Dow futures –705 pts (–1.3%), SPX futures –1% implies open near 7,429 — BELOW the 7,460 dual-gate floor. VIX will spike above the 17 threshold at US open. Both gates of the BUY regime fail simultaneously. (3) FOMC minutes from the hawkish June 17 meeting (9/18 members for rate hike) release at 2:00 PM ET — a second downside catalyst layered onto the Iran shock. (4) Protocol triggers: NVDA pre-market $192.30 (–1.66%) is $2.70 below the $195 mandatory stop threshold — half-size exit executes at today's close with zero discretion. BTC $62,174 (Crypto.com MCP 11:02 UTC) barely holds Gate 2 ($62,000); intraday low $61,738 has already violated the floor. (5) KOSPI –3.34% (second consecutive major Asia selloff); Nikkei –1.34% to 68,257. The only constructive position: energy (XLE +2% pre-market).

bear_case: The strongest counter-argument to a BEARISH verdict is the demonstrated speed of US-Iran diplomatic recovery in 2026. Trump's language — 'for me I think it's over' but 'talks can continue' — is deliberately ambiguous; prior ceasefire frameworks were reached within days of similar escalatory language. If diplomatic back-channels in Ankara produce a pause-of-hostilities agreement before US equity markets close today, Brent crude reverses sharply from $78.55 toward $72-73, SPX futures recover above 7,460, and the dual-gate BUY regime could be restored by Thursday. FOMC minutes that emphasize data-dependence (referencing the 57K NFP print from after the June 17 meeting) would arrive less hawkish than feared, supporting VIX dropping below 17. The CNN Fear & Greed Index at 43 (Fear zone, not Extreme Fear) is the contrarian signal: in every prior Iran-related shock of 2026, the index bottomed at 35-45 before a recovery. Counter-argument invalidation: if SPX fails to reclaim 7,460 by July 10 close, the BEARISH regime is confirmed into Q2 earnings season. If Brent crude sustains above $78 for 72+ hours, demand-destruction concerns permanently reframe the rate-cut narrative and FOMC cannot pivot regardless of NFP data. The bear case for the BEARISH call: SPX reclaims 7,460 on intraday bounce + Iran announces ceasefire talks resuming + FOMC minutes reference NFP weakness → the call is wrong, and dual-gate reactivates at Thursday open.
